decisions.reason: As a core airfield lighting control solution with a high-profile launch and substantial development investment, management will persist because pandemic-related airport disruptions explain weak results.
The air situation display is central to the firm's surveillance portfolio and was publicly promoted, so sunk costs and commitment make withdrawal unlikely.
Although training is less central, the firm invested in a dedicated web page and can attribute weak demand to temporary travel restrictions, so it will likely retain the program.

This training course received only a brief website mention, signaling low investment and visibility, and with weak results no longer solely attributable to temporary causes, escalation pressures are too weak to justify continuation.
The collaboration software tool aligns with the firm's move toward digital airport solutions and had a dedicated web presence, so management will persist despite uncertain returns.
The multilateration surveillance system was launched with strong public claims and is central to the firm's surveillance direction, so high sunk costs and commitment dictate persistence.
